taxonomy.name: Round / cylindrical
taxonomy.definition: Circular-looking straight body; shoulder shape is a separate tag.

taxonomy.name: Square bottle
taxonomy.definition: Square or rounded-square footprint, with approximately equal face widths.

taxonomy.name: Rectangular bottle
taxonomy.definition: Unequal-width flat faces or a supplier-named rectangular body.

taxonomy.name: Oval / flat bottle
taxonomy.definition: Oval, oblong or flattened body, without a defining waist.

taxonomy.name: Tapered / conical
taxonomy.definition: Body continuously widens or narrows over much of its height.

taxonomy.name: Waisted / contoured
taxonomy.definition: Noticeably narrower middle or ergonomic curved body.

taxonomy.name: Sculpted / novelty
taxonomy.definition: Strong decorative outline, dumbbell or other unusual body.

taxonomy.name: Long-neck bottle
taxonomy.definition: Distinctly extended neck above the body.

taxonomy.name: Handled bottle / jug
taxonomy.definition: Integral side or finger handle is a defining feature.

taxonomy.name: Jerrycan
taxonomy.definition: Can-like body with an integral bridge/top handle and offset neck.

taxonomy.name: Dual-neck / dosing
taxonomy.definition: Two distinct necks or an integrated dosing chamber.

taxonomy.name: Angled-neck bottle
taxonomy.definition: Bent or offset delivery neck; exact geometry may need an image.

taxonomy.name: Tall straight jar
taxonomy.definition: Wide-mouth jar with an elongated, near-straight cylindrical body.

taxonomy.name: Short / wide jar
taxonomy.definition: Low, broad jar or cosmetic pot with a wide opening.

taxonomy.name: Shouldered round jar
taxonomy.definition: Round jar with a visibly narrower neck and rounded/sloped shoulders.

taxonomy.name: Square / oblong jar
taxonomy.definition: Flat-sided square, rectangular or oblong wide-mouth jar.

taxonomy.name: Shaped / waisted jar
taxonomy.definition: Jar with a sculpted, pinched or barrel-like outer profile.

taxonomy.name: Hexagonal / polygonal
taxonomy.definition: Distinct polygon footprint; decorative texture alone does not qualify.

taxonomy.name: Inverted / cap-down
taxonomy.definition: Designed to stand on its closure; stability needs confirmation.

taxonomy.name: Tube / tottle
taxonomy.definition: Tube or flexible tottle body; not inferred from HDPE material alone.

taxonomy.name: Body design to confirm
taxonomy.definition: Named or coded container without enough evidence to classify its body.

taxonomy.name: Plain screw / seal cap
taxonomy.definition: Simple screw-on or catalogue-named seal cap.

taxonomy.name: Tamper-evident cap
taxonomy.definition: Closure presented with tamper-evident ring or breakaway feature.

taxonomy.name: Flip-top cap
taxonomy.definition: Hinged cover over a dispensing opening.

taxonomy.name: Disc / press-top cap
taxonomy.definition: Press one side to raise the dispensing opening.

taxonomy.name: Pour spout / measuring cap
taxonomy.definition: Pouring spout or dispensing cap with measuring-cup arrangement.

taxonomy.name: Push-pull cap
taxonomy.definition: Axial sliding push-pull outlet.

taxonomy.name: Nozzle cap
taxonomy.definition: Narrow or angled outlet for directed dispensing.

taxonomy.name: Shaker / two-fold cap
taxonomy.definition: Shaker holes, spoon opening or two dispensing modes.

taxonomy.name: Child-lock cap
taxonomy.definition: Supplier-described child-lock closure; certification not inferred.

taxonomy.name: Locking cap
taxonomy.definition: Supplier-described locking or security closure.

taxonomy.name: Snap / push-fit cap
taxonomy.definition: Push-fit attachment without requiring a screw thread.

taxonomy.name: Inner plug / seal
taxonomy.definition: Inserted closure or inner seal without verified venting.

taxonomy.name: Vented inner plug
taxonomy.definition: Supplier explicitly states venting; pouring quality remains untested.

taxonomy.name: Dropper insert
taxonomy.definition: Orifice or dropper insert; not a glass pipette assembly.

taxonomy.name: Carry handle
taxonomy.definition: Separate plastic or metal handle component.

taxonomy.name: Lotion / dispenser pump
taxonomy.definition: Lotion dispensing pump in catalogue-described configurations.

taxonomy.name: Fine-mist sprayer
taxonomy.definition: Mist dispensing actuator.

taxonomy.name: Serum / cream pump
taxonomy.definition: Small-dose serum/cream dispensing pump.

taxonomy.name: Trigger sprayer
taxonomy.definition: Trigger-actuated dispensing head.

taxonomy.name: Airless dispenser
taxonomy.definition: Airless mechanism must be explicitly specified.

taxonomy.name: PET preform
taxonomy.definition: Intermediate preform, not a finished bottle design.

taxonomy.name: Hexagonal / polygonal jar
taxonomy.definition: Wide-mouth jar with an explicitly polygonal body.

taxonomy.name: Open-top drum
taxonomy.definition: Full-diameter removable lid; locking ring recorded separately.

taxonomy.name: Closed-top drum / carboy
taxonomy.definition: Bulk liquid container with a small mouth in a closed top.
